evidence.title: I can be you. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: I can be you.
summary: Guide to capturing your voice, taste and patterns in one text file you upload to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any AI so it writes like you.
description: A How to AI post arguing that a person fits in a text file. It describes how to extract your writing voice and patterns in about two hours, upload the file to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok, see a session in practice, and keep editing the file often.
